cards.text: Zechariah, a priest, and his wife Elizabeth are old and never had children (Luke 1:5-7). Zechariah hasn't been able to speak since he didn't believe the angel Gabriel's message (Luke 1:19-20). Now Elizabeth's time comes, and she gives birth to a SON!

cards.question: When Elizabeth's neighbors and relatives hear that the Lord has shown her great mercy, they rejoice with her.

cards.text: On the eighth day, they come to circumcise the baby. And they're ready to give him a name.

cards.question: The people who come on the eighth day plan to name the baby after his ___.

cards.text: Then Elizabeth speaks up about that name. And when the new mom speaks up, friend, the whole room better be listening.

cards.question: Elizabeth agrees to name the baby Zechariah, after his father.
Elizabeth replies, "No!" Then what does she say the baby shall be called?

cards.text: The people there push back. Suddenly this baby's name is a group project, and everybody in the room thinks they're the team lead.

cards.question: What do the people there tell Elizabeth about the name John?

answers.text: None of her relatives has that name
The priests already picked a name
Only a king could use that name

cards.text: So they take it to Dad. They make signs to Zechariah to find out what he wants to name the child, and now a room full of grown adults is playing charades with the new father.

cards.question: Zechariah can't speak, so to answer, he asks for a ___.
Zechariah writes the same name Elizabeth chose.

cards.text: He writes, "His name is John." Everybody's amazed, and the name vote just went TWO to NOTHING, with one vote turned in on a tablet.

cards.question: Immediately Zechariah's mouth is opened and his tongue is released. What does he start doing?

cards.text: All the neighbors are filled with awe. People all through the hill country of Judea are talking about these events, and this news is moving faster than a baby announcement in the family group chat.

cards.question: Everyone who hears about it wonders in their hearts. What do they ask?

answers.text: Where did this child come from

cards.question: The Lord's hand was with this child.

cards.text: Then Zechariah is filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesies. Friend, this man went from writing on a TABLET to prophesying OUT LOUD, and that is the comeback of the YEAR.

cards.question: Zechariah begins with "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel," and then gives the reason. What is it?

answers.text: He has visited and redeemed His people
He has rebuilt the temple for His people
He has sent rain on the land of His people

cards.text: Then Zechariah says of God, "He has raised up a horn of salvation for us…"

cards.question: Zechariah says this horn of salvation is raised up in the house of God's servant ___.
Zechariah says no prophet ever spoke of this salvation before.

cards.text: It's salvation from their enemies and from the hand of all who hate them. And it's to show mercy to their fathers and to remember His holy covenant.

cards.question: Zechariah says God's holy covenant is the oath He swore to their father ___.

cards.text: And Zechariah says that oath is to grant them deliverance from hostile hands.

cards.question: Zechariah says God grants deliverance from hostile hands so His people may serve Him. In what way?
Zechariah says God's people will serve Him in holiness and righteousness all the days of their lives.

cards.text: Then Zechariah turns to his newborn son and says, "And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High…" Every new dad talks to his baby like the baby's taking notes, but THIS dad is speaking by the Holy Spirit.

cards.question: Zechariah says John will go on before the Lord. What will John do for Him?

cards.text: And John's job comes with a message. Zechariah says John will give God's people the knowledge of salvation.

cards.question: Zechariah ties this knowledge of salvation to the forgiveness of their sins.

cards.text: Then Zechariah speaks of the tender mercy of God. By that mercy, he says, the Dawn will visit from on high.

cards.question: Zechariah says the Dawn will come to shine. Who will it shine on?

answers.text: Those who live in the palace
Those who live by the temple

cards.text: Friend, I spent years in the dark at the back of a junk drawer, so this line gets me. And Zechariah says the Dawn will guide their feet into the path of peace.

cards.question: The child John grows and becomes strong in spirit, and he lives in the ___ until the time of his public appearance to Israel.

cards.text: Hold that thought, friend. John's out in the wilderness for now, but this story is a LONG way from finished.
